$comment: review-policy.json - the committed DEFAULT policy the review coda reads.
release.py copies it to .release/review-policy.json at coda time; edits made
there are per-release, edits made here are durable. pr_review triage proposes
a disposition for EVERY fresh thread against these rules; the agent confirms
the whole bundle or overrides inline (decision 6). Nothing is auto-dismissed
WITHOUT being shown - this defuses stale-policy over-suppression.
Dispositions: fix | resolve-only | skip. A rule matches on the thread's path
(glob), the comment body (substring, case-insensitive), or both.

known_false_positives.reason: ubuntu-slim is a valid GitHub-hosted runner this repo uses intentionally

PowerShell `-in` with a scalar RHS is a single-element collection, not a character sequence: `'setup' -in 'setup'` is True while `'set' -in 'setup'` and `'s' -in 'setup'` are both False. Verified in pwsh; the single-name verb completers are correct.
